## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the local paper-trading boundary.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes.
- [ ] Ruff lint and format checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation reflects operator-visible changes.
- [ ] Accessibility impacts on documentation, CLI output, and the dashboard are considered; applicable checks and untested areas are recorded.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`, `ASSESSMENT.md`, `FUTURE-UPGRADES.md`, and `COMPLETED-UPGRADES.md` are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, generated databases, or reports are included.
- [ ] Database changes use an Alembic migration.

## Remaining Risks

Document any known limitation, follow-up, or manual deployment step.
